name: Third Bench Inc.
summary: Third Bench Inc. is a company that specializes in providing interior finishes, including cabinets, countertops, and millwork, to clients throughout the Western and Southwestern United States. They offer a full suite of services, encompassing both design and professional installation. Their primary customers are general contractors and residential developers. The entity known today as Third Bench Inc. was formerly named New America Energy Corp. before officially adopting its current name in October 2023. The company's main office is located in Salt Lake City, Utah.
